title: Normalized Listing
description: Canonical record for one asset listing observed on any source platform. Raw platform payloads are preserved verbatim under `raw`; every other top-level object is the normalized, cross-platform view derived from it. Never overwrite `raw` — normalization bugs must be replayable against the original payload.

record_id.description: Stable identity for this listing observation. Re-scrapes of the same live listing update the same record_id; do not mint a new one per crawl pass.

dedup_key.description: Fuzzy-match key (e.g. hash of VIN/serial + platform-agnostic title/price/location signature) used to link the same physical asset across multiple platforms. Populated by the dedup/image-fingerprint pipeline, not the crawler.

platform.description: Source marketplace/dealer/auction house, e.g. IronPlanet, GovPlanet, MachineryTrader.

platform_listing_id.description: The platform's own ID for this listing, if exposed.

first_seen_at.description: First time this listing was observed, across all re-crawls.

market_event_ref.description: FK to a market_event record explaining why this listing exists at this price (e.g. bankruptcy_auction, rental_fleet_refresh) — see market_event.schema.json. Null when no detected event applies.

raw.description: Untouched, platform-specific payload as scraped. Schema intentionally unconstrained — shape varies per source.

verification.description: Third-party data verification/enrichment applied on top of the seller-declared asset.* fields (e.g. EquipmentWatch resolving make/model/year from a decoded serial number, or Sandhills/Rouse confirming spec data). Modeled as a list of providers rather than one hardcoded field per vendor, so adding a new verification API is a data change, not a schema migration.

provider.description: e.g. EquipmentWatch, Sandhills VIP+, Rouse Services.

fields_verified.description: Which asset.* fields this source confirmed or corrected, e.g. ["manufacturer", "model", "year"].

discrepancy_flagged.description: True if any verification source's decoded make/model/year disagreed with the seller-declared asset.* values.

category.description: Controlled vocabulary term, see taxonomy.schema.json (e.g. compact_tractor, skid_steer, mri_machine).

identity_ref.description: Foreign key into asset_identity records once VIN/serial decoding has run.

spec_attributes.description: Category-specific technical specs that don't generalize across verticals — e.g. auxiliary_hydraulics_flow_gpm, track_width_inches, undercarriage_wear_pct, has_enclosed_cab for construction equipment; airframe_hours for aircraft; software_version for medical devices; ISO 15143-3 machineConfiguration fields (boom length, operating weight, hydraulic line count) also land here since they're static per-unit spec, not time-varying telemetry. Free-form by design: a new vertical is a data change here, not a schema migration.

telematics.description: Point-in-time telematics snapshot per ISO 15143-3 (AEMP 2.0), the OEM-agnostic mixed-fleet telemetry standard. Universal across powered equipment (unlike spec_attributes, which is category-idiosyncratic) since any powered asset has hours/idle time/fuel level, so these are named fields rather than free-form. This is a snapshot, not a history — see reported_at, which is the AS-OF key for point-in-time joins (schemas/README.md).

hours_source.description: Provenance of the sibling asset.hours field, not a duplicate hours value.

telematics_provider.description: e.g. John Deere Operations Center, Bobcat Machine IQ — OEM-agnostic field, any ISO 15143-3 publisher.

reported_at.description: When this telematics snapshot was captured. The AS-OF key for point-in-time-correct joins against this listing's telemetry state.

ai_condition_score.description: Output of the computer-vision condition model, not an input.

state_iso_3166_2.description: Normalized ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (e.g. US-TX), aligned with regional_demand.region.code so the two can be joined directly.

compliance.description: Pre-acquisition legal/regulatory gates, checked before transport is booked. See compliance_checklist.md.

has_active_liens.description: Must be resolved false before cross-border transport — a flagged security interest gets the asset seized at the border.

regulatory_flags.description: Category/jurisdiction-specific pre-transport requirements, e.g. usda_cleanliness_inspection for ag equipment, escort_vehicle_required for oversize loads, epa_tier4_compliance for cross-border diesel engines.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code as listed on source; conversion to USD happens downstream, never in place.

auction.description: Populated only when source.listing_type is auction-like.

comparables.description: Cached output of the valuation engine at last scoring pass, not raw input.

regional_nflv.description: Net forced liquidation value — typical basis for reserved-auction sales, see sold_transaction.sale.valuation_basis.

regional_nolv.description: Net orderly liquidation value — typical basis for wholesale/private sales, see sold_transaction.sale.valuation_basis.

provider_valuations.description: Raw valuations pulled from third-party pricing services (e.g. Rouse Services, EquipmentWatch, Sandhills VIP+/FleetEvaluator), kept distinct from Atlas's own blended regional_fmv/olv/flv above so the blend inputs stay auditable.

friction.description: Denormalized snapshot of latest logistics_friction estimate for this listing; see logistics_friction.schema.json for the source-of-truth record.

scoring.description: Output of the Opportunity Engine / Buy Score model. Always model-derived; never hand-entered.

model_version.description: Buy Score model version that produced this scoring block.
